chunks: (God) will say: 'Because Our signs came to you, but you disregarded them. So shall We disregard you this day.'

key_terms.آيَاتُنَا: Our signs (verses of God or divine indicators)

ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of 'So shall We disregard you this day' in Surah Taa-Haa?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse illustrates the principle of *tadabbur* (reflection) and its absence, where the disbeliever's willful neglect of divine signs (*ayat*) in the world results in a reciprocal divine neglect (*tunsa*) on the Day of Judgment. This reciprocal state signifies not merely being forgotten, but being left without guidance or mercy, emphasizing the causal link between human agency and divine retribution.
